description: The ZALF version-three deposit provides daily observed and scenario climate values on a 25-by-25-kilometre European grid for crop-model simulations. It contains a baseline for 1980–2010 and future scenario periods 2040–2069 and 2070–2099, using several global climate models and forcing paths. The article describes version three as an expansion to 9,220 grid cells and a correction to vapour-pressure and dew-point scenario values. The named ZALF repository layer opened publicly, and DataCite lists CC BY 4.0. A food-supply modeller can use the series to drive crop-yield or climate-adaptation scenarios over the covered European regions. These are scenario-adjusted weather inputs, not observed future conditions or direct crop production forecasts. The gridded values can miss local extremes and require matching the crop model grid and calendar. Earlier versions are available for comparison with published studies, but the article recommends this corrected version for new work. The compressed data package and individual variables were not inspected by download. No directly related catalogue record was found in the full identity scan.
